news.text: #JUVE-#LUCUMÍ, WE ARE THEREFOR THE GOAL, #VICARIO IS BACK ON THE RISE#Carnevali, #Massara and #Ottolini in Bologna to close the deal. An agreement is one step away for the defender, confidence is growing to have him by Monday. #Suzuki deal falls through: #PSG is not convinced about #Chevalier and has taken time, irritating the bianconeri who have changed their objective. Contacts have been re-established with #Tottenham for the Italian: they are negotiating a loan.[Front Page TuttoSport]
‼️#Juventus is not interested in a simple loan for Zion #Suzuki. And #PSG has not opened to different conditions.[Mirko Di Natale]

❌ "The loan of Zion #Suzuki to #Juventus is almost completely ruled out.#PSG delayed the deal and the bianconero management, annoyed by the hold-ups, decided to pull out and look for other options.#Juve is looking for a goalkeeper strictly on loan.Guglielmo #Vicario (#Tottenham) is the most viable option if the English accept a loan with an option to buy, although there are other names on the list.Andriy #Lunin is ruled out, as #RealMadrid will not loan him out.Michele #DiGregorio will not play against #Frosinone.#Juve is seeking an urgent loan exit for him to any club that presents an offer (there are rumors of #Torino)."[@romeoagresti on @twotalkstv via @PuebloJ]

🧤🤔 "#PSG did not tell #Juventus that #Suzuki will no longer be loaned out, but they are taking their time. The inclination is to loan him out, but first they want to see if they can place #Chevalier elsewhere. The now ex #Parma does not want to be a mail package, he wants to have a clear medium-to-long-term plan. The bianconeri have mobilized because they do not want to wait so long: by the end of the week, they want to identify the new number one."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
✅ #Bologna is the club furthest ahead for Juan #Cabal.[Mirko Di Natale]

#Juve, in the early afternoon summit, #PSG told the bianconeri that they want to keep #Suzuki for the time being, effectively changing the cards on the table. The French are aiming for the sale of #Chevalier. La Signora has #Vicario in hand but has also spoken with other goalkeepers.[Eleonora Trotta]

🧤🤨 "In the coming hours, we will also speak about the goalkeeper. So many things are coming out: we woke up with everyone saying #Suzuki-#Juventus was a done deal and we are going to sleep with everyone saying that it is no longer happening. In the coming hours, we will bring more clarity as soon as there is certain news, rather than going around saying things that can change in 5 minutes."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴✅ "#Juventus has reached this evening a verbal agreement with #Bologna for #Lucumí following a contact after dinner time. The deal will touch €20M with bonuses, tomorrow there will be the exchange of documents and the approval of the latest details. He is expected to arrive on Sunday. He has already spoken with #Spalletti: the coach was one of the important figures in bringing him."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus has raised the offer to #Bologna for #Lucumi: 20 million + bonuses to bring everyone to an agreement. His arrival in Turin is scheduled for Sunday.[Michele De Blasis]
‼️#Bologna will not have a % on the future resale of Jhon #Lucumi.[Mirko Di Natale]

We are truly very close to an agreement. The hope is to close during the weekend and Monday/Tuesday as possible dates for the formal finalization, medical examinations and signatures."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
